svg.title: What GitHub Actions checks before running an onboarded workflow
svg.desc: For a workflow onboarded to .github/workflows/actions.lock, five checks must pass: every uses dependency has a lockfile entry, the owner_id and repo_id still match, the locked commit still exists on a branch of the source repository, full-version tags still point at the locked commit, and allowed-actions policies are checked against the locked SHA. If any check fails, the run is blocked. If all pass, the runner executes the locked commit even if the tag or branch has moved.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, system-ui, -apple-system, Segoe UI, sans-serif
